response_contract.format: 0.1 degree gridded annual mean flash rate, annual/diurnal cycle and mission-specific time series
response_contract.scientific_semantics: NASA catalog https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/lis-otd-reprocessed-flash-climatology identifies US government works rights label and collection C3671144020-GHRC_DAAC; paper https://doi.org/10.1175/JAMC-D-25-0110.1. Live anonymous CMR granule query on 2026-11-25 returned COMB_OTD_TRMM_ISS_AnnualMean.hdf, COMB_OTD_TRMM_ISS_AnnualDiurnalCycle.hdf, COMB_OTD_TRMM_ISS_AnnualCycle.hdf and OTD monthly/annual files under https://data.ghrc.earthdata.nasa.gov/ghrcw-protected/lorfc__2/. Combined granules span 1995-04-13 to 2023-11-16; not continuous observing time. CMR reported granule_size 0, not evidence files are empty or free to acquire. Exact version, Earthdata account and HDF reader required; review mission-specific rights, detection efficiency, observation opportunity, time bins and units. No original payload downloaded. Use as frequency/diurnal context, not hail events.
